subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Affinity Fraud: Preying on Communities
description: Learn Affinity Fraud: Preying on Communities in one minute.

hook.text: The most devastating Ponzi schemes target churches, ethnic groups, and veterans' organizations.

buildup.text: Scammers join a community, build trust, then offer exclusive investment 'opportunities.'

discovery.text: Victims recruit friends within the group. Shared identity replaces financial due diligence.

twist.text: Reporting the fraud means betraying the community. Many victims stay silent for years.

climax.text: Affinity fraud destroys not just savings but the social bonds that held communities together.

punchline.text: Trust is a community's strength — and its vulnerability.

quiz.question: Why is affinity fraud particularly destructive?
options: It destroys community bonds along with savings
